shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find .agents -type f && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80 && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -30 && find src -type f | xargs ls -la && cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ ; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "Button view" -A3 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -40; grep -n -i "modal\|dialog" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Dialog/Dialog.d.ts Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls Dialog/DialogFooter; cat Dialog/index.d.ts; cat Dialog/DialogFooter/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat Button/Button.d.ts | head -80

cat Dialog/DialogHeader/DialogHeader.d.ts Dialog/DialogBody/DialogBody.d.ts; grep -n "ModalCloseReason" -A2 Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -8; grep -n "view=\|BUTTON_VIEWS" -A3 Button/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
